purpose: Test one universal weak-field metric in which massive tracers use the RAR-coherent time potential and photons use the topology-complete routed Weyl potential.

nuisance_fit.source_positions: two coordinates profiled independently for seven spectroscopic families on training images
nuisance_fit.map_interpolation: bicubic; no metric potential amplitude, slip coefficient, gravity amplitude, photon amplitude, routing fraction, mass sheet, ellipticity, rotation, or radial scale is fitted

selection_rule: Advance only if P0706 passes and every inherited numerical, DDO154, RX J2129 root, RMS, compact-halo, topology, nuisance, and accounting gate passes. No photon multiplier, slip parameter, or endpoint amplitude may be introduced after the score.
if_pass: Freeze map-systematic robustness and a prediction manifest for every P0633/P0640 target before opening any sealed outcome.
if_fail: Retire this exact two-potential metric and keep P0633/P0640 sealed.
claim_boundary: P0707 is post hoc on fully spent DDO154 and RX J2129 evidence and requires external validation.
Matter and light follow one metric but probe different canonical combinations of its two potentials; no object label selects a law.
The weak-field metric has no covariant action or stability proof yet.
P0633 galaxy kinematics and P0640 raw lensing constraints remain sealed regardless of the result.
